items.question: Do I need to be a professional photographer?
items.answer: No. Our Personal Paparazzi aren't necessarily professional photographers, in the same way rideshare drivers weren't professional drivers before joining. You need a good eye and a modern phone camera.

items.question: What do I get paid?
items.answer: You keep 50% of the price: $10.00 a session, and 100% of any tip. Earnings are deposited weekly, once the client receives their images.

items.question: How long does one session take?
items.answer: The session itself typically takes less than five minutes. You take nine photos and one short video, and they upload automatically.

items.question: What equipment do I need?
items.answer: A modern smartphone with a good camera. No professional equipment is required, and we'll provide tips and guidance to help you deliver great results.

items.question: Do I have to work set hours?
items.answer: No. Work whenever you want, with no set schedule. Position yourself near popular spots and accept the requests you want.

items.question: What checks do I have to pass?
items.answer: An identity verification: we confirm you are who you say you are. You also need to be 18 or older and to complete a short onboarding process.
